title: acs pipeline-state.json
description: Compact per-ticket step ledger. /ship reads this single file to pick the next step or resume, so its context can be cleared at any step boundary. Maintained by post-hooks and skill-start.

flow.description: ticket = the ticket delivery pipeline workflows/ship.yaml declares; product = a product-level delivery ticket (PRD / architecture / scaffold).

delivery_path.description: The delivery path this ticket was judged onto, once, from its plan (ADR-0095). Written by /acs:ship (or by /acs:code when a ticket reaches it unclassified) through `acs.py path set`, and READ by every later walk — a resumed run never re-judges. Its value is one of the names workflows/ship.yaml's `delivery.paths` declares; absent means the classification has not happened yet.

delivery_path_reason.description: One sentence naming what in the plan decided the path. Recorded beside it so the choice is auditable: /acs:code's review reads it back in the Path audit dimension and judges the changeset against it.

propertyNames.description: A delivery-path leg (code-trivial and its siblings) never appears here: a leg is an implementation of the `code` step, and everything it writes on disk is `code`'s (ADR-0095).

status.description: skipped = workflows/ship.yaml recorded this step as not applicable for this ticket — either its `when` predicate is false, or its `paths` list does not contain the ticket's delivery_path. It counts as satisfied for the walk and is never re-run unless that reason stops holding.

summary.description: Compact handoff summary for /ship (bounded; full detail lives in the skill state files).

fix_loops.description: Bounded fix-and-re-test loop counter for the test step only; other steps never set this. Independent of /code's own internal iteration cap.

totals.description: Per-ticket roll-up across all skills and runs.
